parameters.query:
SELECT session_id, role, content, created_at
FROM chat_history
WHERE session_id !~ '^__'
  AND session_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM chat_history
    WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires'
      AND session_id !~ '^__'
  )
ORDER BY session_id, created_at
SELECT replace(session_id, '__ad_source__:', '') AS session_id FROM chat_history WHERE session_id LIKE '__ad_source__:%'
